As per Issue #443, just wanted to open up some discussion regarding the possibility of a feature similar to this. The main motivation being:

Because profile history is currently public and this is enabling some people who disagree with just one of your comments to go through your entire profile history and downvote everything in a sort of internet revenge spree without having any desire to interact or discuss their actions.

Obviously this suggestion has been met with some criticism, but we're a community of open minded and intelligent folk, aren't we? How can we mitigate this issue?
[Discussion] Disable downvoting on comments older than 7 days. Github Issue #443

To begin, my two cents...

While it's a tough question and some very good points were raised over on Github, I believe this idea has quite a deal of merit, however implementation is always going to be particularly hard.

Perhaps one such implementation could be to allow the continuation of voting into the future as it's still important to have the freedom encourage good ideas and discourage bad ones. Rather than directly change the amount of upvotes/downvotes, a tag could be added to the post to show that it is a comment or post which is still being visited. Maybe a [Historic] tag for tags which continue to be upvoted into the future and a [Controversial] tag for any posts which are downvoted. By leaving the voting figures the same after the discussion has finished, this would allow the upvote/downvote mechanism to contribute usefully to the discourse while it is happening by giving a metric for how much the community agrees with ideas, then the future votes only effect visibility and tags.

The Sizzler Kebab on Spadina is a hole in the wall, but their food is first class. They even make their own ice cream. It's a bit on the expensive side, but family style meal is well worth it. Channa, kebabs and naan are excellent.

Curry Twist on Dundas West at High Park - - absolutely delicious Indian food and well worth the trip to the west end.

Patrician Grill diner on King Street East and Sherbourne. Old-time diner atmosphere and great food. The breakfast special is a classic favourite.
